How It Works

Your AGM. Live and broadcast.

Your location. Your show.

We can come to you, turning your own space into an event space. Sofas, warm lighting, an intimate layout. Somewhere between a podcast and a fireside chat. Premium conversation rather than boardroom presentation. No hired studio costs. Your environment, transformed.

Read more

Four cameras. One live gallery.

A four camera shoot with a small live gallery mixing the event in real time. Wide shots, close ups, cutaways. Switched live as the conversation unfolds. We help plan the day and floor manage it to make sure it all runs smoothly. Broadcast privately to your whole company via a secure, password protected link. Only the people you invite can watch.

Read more

Live. Interactive. Your audience.

We can do it live, or run it as a remote Q&A. Audiences both in the room and watching remotely can submit questions. We add name straps, graphics and titles throughout. If you want produced video content cut into the broadcast, things like company updates or messages from leadership, we handle that too.

Read more

Post-show.

Once the broadcast is done, we can edit it down into whatever you need.

• Highlights reel
• Social cutdowns
• Longform archive
• Short internal updates

However you want it, we can deliver it. Even all as one long piece, so anyone who missed the event can watch online on a secure, password protected platform.

Prefer a studio?

If a dedicated studio environment suits you better, we can arrange that too. A studio gives you a clean, fully controlled backdrop that can be dressed and branded exactly to your spec. The tradeoff is scale. For a live audience you would need a larger space. We can talk through both options.

Budget Considerations

Help us build your quote

Every AGM is different. The cost depends on a number of factors, and we want to make sure we quote you accurately, not just give you a number that does not reflect what you actually need. Answer the questions below and we will come back to you with a proposal built around your event.

If you are planning an early start, we may need to set up the day before. That affects the crew schedule and cost.
Roughly. Morning only, half day, full day?
If we need to source a venue, we will factor in hire costs and check what furnishings and facilities are available on site. Wherever we film, we need to be able to control the lighting. We will bring and manage all lighting as part of our technical provision.
This helps us plan the right audio setup. We will mic all speakers directly and scale the audio provision to suit the size of the room and audience.
This helps us spec the right broadcast setup and ensure the stream is stable for everyone watching.
A live mix means a vision mixer in the gallery switching cameras in real time. Editing afterwards happens in post production. Both have different cost implications.
We can arrange a professional photographer to capture stills of the event alongside our filming crew.
All productions include full health and safety documentation including risk assessment, movement order, power usage summary and relevant venue paperwork submitted in advance of the event. Footage is securely stored for three months as standard.
